$comment: Shared design tokens. Source of truth for iPhone (ios/OnMission/Shared/Design/Tokens.swift) and the web app (web/assets/app.css). Look: the Tomato Flood screens (tomato-flood/prototype.html, HANDOFF.md) in hesent.me’s paper and ink (site/public/assets/tokens.css), as the web app draws them. The Windows helper still uses the older Mocha look in its own theme files.
name: Tomato Flood on paper

$use.paper: The sheet, whole paper pages, text on ink
$use.paperDeep: The tab bar under a poster
$use.flood: Posters, with the paper texture multiplied in
$use.ink: Text, line art, primary buttons, the active pill, rings and outlines
$use.sageDeep: Done: ticked rings, full progress, papers in, money in; tile icons and asides
$use.sage: The toast check, the packed level
$use.ochre: The Answered! flood and the Thinking check-in
$use.coral: The Yes! check-in, the flame, the SOLD and ALL IN stamps, the caret

barModes.$comment: The tab bar takes the colour of what sits at the bottom of the screen. Top wins: gold while Answered is up; a pushed page's own mode; the tab's mode.

font.$comment: Archivo only, as on hesent.me: the variable font (wdth 62–125, wght 100–900), OFL, bundled in ios/OnMission/Resources/Fonts. Sentence case everywhere.

hand.$comment: Was Caveat. Archivo at the old handwriting x-height: the font size is 0.34/0.526 of the given size.

layout.$comment: Posters are designed on a 390 × 844 canvas and scale with the phone; the sheet of a pushed page starts at 410.

motion.$comment: CSS cubic-bezier control points and durations in seconds. Every moment has a Reduce Motion fallback (HANDOFF.md §9).

icons.$comment: Lucide geometry (ISC) with motion ported from lucide-animated by pqoqubbw (MIT). Credited in Settings › About.

brand.$comment: App name chosen 2026-10-11: hesent.me. Read it from here, never hard-code it.

texture.paper: ios/OnMission/Resources/Texture/paper.webp (web/assets/texture/paper.webp): 1024px, tiled at 512pt. Laid on the sheet; multiplied into the poster.

art.$comment: Colour illustrations from hesent.me, bundled in ios/OnMission/Resources/Art. Never redrawn in code.
